answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn trust only through verified work that cannot be transferred or sold. A new identity may enter the harbor, but it starts with no history and wins larger tasks only by completing small checked jobs well. Trust grows like a vine, link by link, so copying an identity copies nothing of value. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund, age, and maintain every fake separately, and bad work is slashed, while falcon-sharp audits catch reused patterns across identities.
